block.airtable.model.title: Airtable
block.airtable.model.description: List, create, update and upsert records in an Airtable base.
block.airtable.security_hint: The access token stays in the wallet. Nothing is written until Allow writes is enabled.
block.airtable.apply_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Restart a loaded Run to use new settings.
block.airtable.invalid_number: Check the numeric value and its limits.
block.airtable.help_enabled: Off by default. While off, no request reaches Airtable and the wallet is never read.
block.airtable.help_secret_ref: Wallet reference holding an Airtable personal access token, or JSON with token. Never the token itself.
block.airtable.help_base_id: The app… ID from the base URL. Each node works on this one base only.
block.airtable.help_table: Default table name or tbl… ID. A request may name another table of the same base.
block.airtable.help_view: Optional default view name or viw… ID for list_records: its filters and sort apply.
block.airtable.help_operation: Used when a request gives no operation. Write operations need Allow writes.
block.airtable.help_allowed_operations: JSON array among ["list_records", "get_record", "create_records", "update_records", "upsert_records", "delete_records"]. The default operation is always allowed.
block.airtable.help_read_limit: Upper bound for one list_records; a request max_records can only lower it.
block.airtable.help_allow_writes: Off by default. Required for create_records, update_records, upsert_records and delete_records.
block.airtable.help_typecast: Let Airtable convert text to the field type and create missing select options. Off keeps values strict.
block.airtable.help_fields_to_merge_on: JSON array of 1-3 field names that identify a record for upsert_records, for example ["Email"]. A request may give its own.
block.airtable.help_max_write_records: Larger requests are refused before any request. Records are sent in batches of 10.
block.airtable.help_allow_delete: Separate switch for deleting records by ID. Treat a deletion as final.
block.airtable.help_page_size: pageSize sent to Airtable, at most 100. A request may lower it.
block.airtable.help_max_pages: Pages per list_records; when reached, the result gives offset to continue.
block.airtable.help_return_fields_by_fie: Return fields keyed by fld… IDs instead of names, so renaming a field does not break a workflow.
block.airtable.help_timeout_sec: Total time for one request, pages, batches, pacing and retries included.
block.airtable.help_max_requests_per_sec: Pacing per base for this process. Airtable allows 5 requests per second per base.
block.airtable.help_max_retries: Reads retry after HTTP 429, 5xx or a lost connection; writes only after HTTP 429.
block.airtable.help_max_retry_wait_sec: A Retry-After above this value returns rate_limited instead of waiting. Without Retry-After, Airtable asks for 30 s.
block.airtable.help_max_request_bytes: Bound for the incoming request and for each JSON body sent to Airtable.
block.airtable.help_max_response_bytes: Larger Airtable responses are refused as protocol errors.
block.airtable.help_api_base_url: Keep https://api.airtable.com. Another origin receives the token; plain HTTP only for a loopback test host.
block.airtable.help_ca_file: Optional absolute PEM file for a privately signed HTTPS origin. TLS verification cannot be disabled.
